finalText:
**Big, but most of it must not move.** `1291` hits in `94` files.

| Zone | Files | Rename |
|---|---|---|
| `services/*` JS names | 75 | yes |
| SQL text inside those repos | 25 | no, column is still `account_id` |
| `migrations/*.sql` | 12 | no, all applied in prod |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk` | 4 | no, regenerated on refresh |
| `docs/openapi.yaml` | 1 | no, public contract |

`WIRE` in [lib/serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js:8) is the seam. Left side may change. Right side is frozen. Keep the JSONB `payload` key as is too.

Next: sign off only if the diff spares those four zones.
